Name: Tolerable Demetrius
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]★ nerdy science dad! — now with 100% less arrogance and 50% more acknowledgement of the existence of his stepson ★[/size][/font]

[b]
features[/b]

[list]
[*]changes the whole tomatoes event so that instead of demetrius purposefully misunderstanding robin and being condescending and rude for no reason, it's just a fun and casual conversation about science and fruit salad
[*]changes the helping-maru-and-demetrius-with-science event so demetrius is no longer creepily possessive of maru, especially for when the farmer is already married????? and/or maybe just wants to be friends with maru?? like dude relax
[*]tweaks a couple random bits of dialogue to be nicer to sebastian
[*]other random dialogue changes to make demetrius generally kinder to his family and a bit more likeable imo
[/list]

[b]installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿
[*]unzip mod folder into [code]stardew valley/mods[/code]
[*]that's it. congrats
[/list]
